Job Description

We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at &lt;a href="http://www.digicert.com/"&gt;www.digicert.com&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Job summary&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"&gt;As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in combining technical expertise with strong sales acumen to identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities across a defined portfolio of customer and partner accounts.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"&gt;Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve close collaboration with customers, partners, and Account Managers to deliver business value, conduct demos and POC/Vs, and contribute to the success of bids and tenders. You will provide end-to-end technical and business value guidance before and during the sales cycle ensuring customer requirements are met with tailored, innovative solutions.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"&gt;Acting as a trusted technical advisor, you will be a key point of contact for clients, offering strategic insight and hands-on support. You'll also work closely with cross-functional teams to align solutions with customer needs and organizational goals.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;
